svg.title: A stationary Lawlor neck
svg.desc: Exact coordinates · projection of a special Lagrangian annulus in C²

g.text: Exact coordinates · projection of a special Lagrangian annulus in C²
a₁ = a₂ = 1; α = 0. This is a minimal surface, constant under mean curvature flow.
The full surface has two planar ends; the drawing is truncated at |y| = 2.8.
